Knockout Outdoor: Level Up music festival at Sydney Showground on Saturday 3 October. Event starts at 3pm and finishes 11pm.

  • With a sold-out crowd of 60,000 people expected, traffic will be heavy on roads approaching Sydney Olympic Park.

  • If you have to drive, carpool with your group pre-book your parking online ahead of time to secure a space – available until 11:59pm the night before the event unless sold out prior. If you have pre-booked your parking, follow the directions of staff and have your parking ticket ready to show at the car park entry.
  • Roads will be closed in the precinct for the safety of event crowds arriving and leaving the venue. For road closure details, visit the Sydney Olympic Park interactive map for more details.

Thousands of cyclists will take part in Spring Cycle 10km or 50km events from North Sydney to Pyrmont or Parramatta Park. Road closures will be in place along the first 10km to Pyrmont, from there cyclists will continue on to Parramatta Park sharing roads with motorists and abiding by general road rules.

ROAD CLOSURES - 4AM TO 11:30AM:

  • Cahill Expressway and Sydney Harbour Bridge: from 4am to 10:30am the Cahill Expressway lanes 7 and 8, including Mount St and High St on ramps will be closed. On the Sydney Harbour Bridge deck, lanes 3 and 6 will be closed – two lanes will remain open in both directions under a reduced 40km/h speed limit. From 4am to 11am the Cahill Expressway Circular Quay Overpass will be closed in both directions.
  • North Sydney between 4am and 11am: Miller St from Falcon St to Pacific Hwy, Berry St from Pacific Hwy to Walker St, sections of Arthur St, Carlow St, Blue St and surrounding local roads including the High St bridge on-ramp.
  • Sydney CBD, The Rocks and Millers Point between 4am and 11am: including Hickson Rd southbound from Towns Place to Erskine St, Napoleon St, King St, Sussex St and sections of Argyle St, Dalgety Rd and Upper Fort St.
  • Western Distributor from Pyrmont to the City from 4am to 11.15am: including Pyrmont on-ramp, Fig St on-ramp and King St off-ramp. Citybound motorists from the Anzac Bridge will be diverted via the Bathurst St off-ramp to re-join the Harbour Bridge or access City North via Harbour St or Kent St.
  • Pyrmont and Ultimo between 4am and 11:30am: on sections of Pyrmont St, Pirrama Rd, Pyrmont Bridge Rd, Union St, Murray St and surrounding local roads. Cycleway closure from 4am to 11am on Union St between Edward St and Murray St (eastbound)
  • Parramatta Park: the park will be closed to all vehicles from 6am to 2pm.

Special event clearways will be in effect on roads along sections of the course in North Sydney, Millers Point and Pyrmont between 3am and 11am and in Five Dock, Ultimo, Wareemba and Concord between 5am and 11am.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
